零点禁制森严，爱被囚于黑暗深渊。
她却似暗夜恶魔， 在零点临近时，
以魅惑低语撩拨心弦， 眼神如星芒闪烁诱惑。
终在禁忌的拉扯下，于零点挣脱部分禁制，
与她沉沦在这危险而迷人的，爱之漩涡， 哪怕万劫不复。
彼之良·曼陀罗【零点禁制/仿生2.2CF系列/155Mcm】

At midnight, love is imprisoned in the darkness of the abyss.
But she emerges as a nocturnal demon, when the midnight hour approaches,
entwining hearts with seductive whispers, eyes glinting with starlit temptation.
Finally under the taboo's thrall, she shatters part of the prohibition at zero hour,
sinking together into this perilous yet rapturous vortex of passion, even at the cost of eternal damnation.
Bezlya Mandragora ProhibitionMidnight, Bionic 2.2CF series 155cm M ver
